plans.title: Multi-source literature refresh with exact provenance
deliverables: refresh identifies the actual matching binding instead of always selecting the first
cross-source dedup accounting and CLI receipts
tests covering DAIR.AI plus GitHub and rejected adapter/binding mismatches
acceptance_checks: A run ingests two validated adapter runs in order and retains both exact binding ids and artifact hashes
Refreshing with an adapter run that does not match any declared binding fails without advancing or writing partial state
Duplicate content across sources is represented once while preserving both provenance references

plans.title: Question decomposition and coverage contract
deliverables: coverage gaps in status and owner review
acceptance_checks: Every atomic subquestion is covered or explicitly marked as a gap before selection completes
A light-tier run may use a smaller workflow without silently skipping required states
Status names one valid next command and the predecessor artifact it requires

plans.title: Adversarial evidence and claim-verification gate
deliverables: critical support failure gate in review
acceptance_checks: A mechanism supported only by a claim whose locator cannot be reproduced is rejected
One bounded gap refresh can add evidence while a second loop is refused unless a new run is opened
The owner packet lists unresolved contradictions, source limitations, and verification failures
Temporary full text is deleted while hashes, locators, and verification results remain reproducible
